description.value:
You channel purifying Force energy into your weapon and strike. As part of the action, you must make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and the target becomes wrapped in a faint barrier of force energy until the start of your next turn. If it willingly moves before then, the barrier bursts, dealing 1d8 force damage and ending the power.

The bonus damage from the melee attack and the damage dealt for moving both increase by 1d8 at 5th level, and again at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, At-Will
